title.zh: 图像系列模型（目录期初）

summary.en: Image generation SKUs on live pricing: GPT Image 2, Nano Banana, Z-Image makeup.
summary.zh: live 定价上的图像 SKU：GPT Image 2、Nano Banana、Z-Image 美妆。

body.en:
Image generation models available on the gateway as of this baseline.

## Models

| Model id | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| `gpt-image2` | GPT Image 2 primary SKU |
| `gpt-image2-hd` | Higher-detail / HD tier |
| `nano_banana_2` | Nano Banana 2 image family |
| `nano_banana_pro` | Nano Banana Pro |
| `zimage-makeup` | Makeup / beauty workflow-oriented image model |

## Documentation

See **Image series** in the API manual. Always pin the exact model id from live pricing.
